newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila SEC stops Dizon stockholder meeting.
newsitem.headline: Manila SEC stops Dizon stockholder meeting.

text.p: The Philippine Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) on Wednesday ordered Dizon Copper-Silver Mines Inc to stop its scheduled stockholders' to verify minority owners claims that it violated SEC rules.

The SEC ordered Dizon to reset its meeting which was to be held on Wednesday after minority shareholders complained of violation in the counting of proxies of current stockholders, documents from the SEC showed.
Under SEC rules, validation of proxies must be made at least 10 days before the stockholders' meeting.

But minority shareholders complained of "massive" proliferation of questionable proxy voting certificates for the planned election of new officers of the company for the coming year, SEC lawyer Ruben Ladia said.

"A reading from the petition filed by (minority shareholders) showed that the annual stockholders' meeting is scheduled to be held on (Wednesday) while the validation of proxies is being undertaken only today," Ladia said.
